description: Transporting a first-order structure along a bijection makes that same bijection a structure isomorphism. The transported functions are conjugated by the bijection, and the transported relations are its inverse images.
signature:
Equiv.inducedStructureEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} [L.Structure M]
  (e : M ≃ N) : L.Equiv M N
